The '''ID scanner''' was a device used by [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]] to identify potential targets.

==Known users==
[[File:FettInterrogatesGloom-SWBH.jpg|thumb|right|220px|Fett's helmet had an ID scanner  to scan his target.]]
The [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]] had an ID scanner attached to [[Gender/Legends|his]] [[Helmet/Legends|helmet]]. When Jango was on a mission, his ally [[Rozatta]] transmitted [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] information to the scanner, which allowed the scanner to identify bounties. When Jango scanned a bounty, his ID scanner displayed information about the bounty, including his or her name, gender, species, known affiliates, last known location, reward amount, whether the bounty was wanted dead or alive, what the bounty was wanted for, and the name of the person or organization that posted the bounty.<ref name="swbh">''[[Star Wars: Bounty Hunter]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The ID scanner first appeared in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Bounty Hunter]]'' by [[LucasArts]]. In the game, Jango Fett used it to identify characters with bounties.
